gloss: to freeze; to cower; to be paralyzed (with fear)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: すくんでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to freeze, to cower, to be paralyzed with fear
definitions.explanation: To become unable to move or act due to fear, shock, or nervousness. The body stiffens and one cannot take action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すくんだ。
⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{吠|ほ}えられて→吠える：02415_hoeru⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すくんだ。
examples.english: A big dog barked at me and I froze up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すくんで⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{動|うご}けなく→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I looked down from the high place, my legs froze and I couldn't move a single step.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すくむ: one's legs freeze/give way (most common)
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すくむ: one's body freezes
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧すくむ: to freeze with fear

PAIR: すくむ（⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧）↔ ⟦すくめる→すくめる：10357_sukumeru⟧（⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧）= to shrug, to hunch (as in ⟦{肩|かた}をすくめる→肩をすくめる：06896_katawosukumeru⟧)

USAGE: Most commonly used in the pattern ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すくむ to describe being unable to move due to fear, especially of heights.
